parsed.title: Overlap slow LLM calls with fast embedding work to hide latency
parsed.body: Claude's per-batch processing (~5s) dominates indexing time while embedding generation is cheap (~50ms), so embeddings for batch N run in a background thread while Claude processes batch N+1, and query embeddings are computed concurrently with search context setup. This pipelining hides the fast operation's latency entirely behind the slow one instead of running them sequentially.

parsed.title: Two-pass semantic search avoids deserializing rows that get discarded
parsed.body: Semantic search originally loaded full rows (including JSON file arrays and strings) for every indexed item just to compute cosine similarity. Switching to a two-pass approach—score raw (id, embedding) pairs first, then fetch full rows only for the top-N matches—cuts unnecessary deserialization and allocation for rows that never make it into the results.

parsed.title: Deep search redesigned as iterative single-action agentic loop, not parallel strategy fan-out
parsed.body: The original deep search generated multiple search strategies upfront and ran them all in parallel, merging results into a single set for synthesis. This was replaced with an iterative loop where Claude takes one action at a time (search, git_show, read_file) based on what it just learned, mimicking how a human researcher follows threads of interest up to 10 steps. The upfront-fanout approach couldn't adapt to surprising findings mid-research, so sequential single-step reasoning was needed to let discoveries guide the next query.

parsed.body: Long-running agentic loops need user feedback, but writing progress indicators to stdout would break downstream consumers piping the command's output. A braille spinner was added on stderr so the terminal stays responsive during the research loop while stdout remains clean for programmatic use.

subject: v0.8.0: background loading spinner, service subdomain rename, protocol-aware URLs

parsed.title: Move blocking Cloudflare API calls off the UI thread using mpsc channels
parsed.body: Direct synchronous CF API calls were blocking the TUI, so all network operations (sync, route management, token verification) were moved to background threads communicating via mpsc channels. The TUI now renders instantly from local cached data while CF syncs asynchronously, with input blocked during loading to prevent duplicate triggers. This establishes a BgResult enum pattern for routing async results back into app state.

parsed.title: Lock domain suffix when renaming service subdomains
parsed.body: The new `m` rename keybinding on the Services tab only allows editing the subdomain prefix, keeping the domain suffix locked. This prevents accidental cross-domain renames and keeps the UX scoped to the common use case of just changing the service name.

parsed.title: Service URLs hardcoded https:// regardless of tunnel protocol
parsed.body: Non-HTTP tunnel services (ssh, tcp, rdp) were displayed with a hardcoded https:// prefix, which was misleading since those protocols aren't web-based. The fix makes the Services tab protocol-aware, deriving the correct URL scheme from the tunnel's actual protocol configuration.
